system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson, in dark tweed and ulster, stepping out of a gate onto a dark road","action":"Holmes springs to his feet and strides out into the night, Watson following, both turning toward the single distant light","setting":"Dark country road near Stoke Moran Manor, Surrey, bordered by hedgerows and trees, moonless night","secondaryElements":"A lone yellow lamp glimmering through the gloom far ahead, faint silhouette of the manor's upper window, a chill wind stirring the trees, shoes removed from view","mood":"Tense, sombre, gothic anticipation with dry restraint","timeOfDay":"Late night, around eleven o'clock, total darkness","composition":"Wide shot from behind the two figures, small yellow light centred in the distance, dark road leading the eye toward it"}
